stock_movements_sign.name: stock_movements_sign
stock_movements_sign.value: ("stock_movements"."kind"::text IN ('consumo','venta') AND "stock_movements"."qty_delta" <= 0) OR ("stock_movements"."kind"::text IN ('ajuste_inicial','ingreso','devolucion') AND "stock_movements"."qty_delta" >= 0) OR ("stock_movements"."kind"::text = 'ajuste_pedido' AND "stock_movements"."qty_delta" <> 0)

store_promo_window_order.name: store_promo_window_order
store_promo_window_order.value: "store_promo"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "store_promo"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "store_promo"."ends_at" > "store_promo"."starts_at"
